params.text:
### What the live trace demonstrates
- Pockels-cell assembly attenuates the pulsed writing path
- resonant X and slow-Y mirrors move the downstream focus
- the objective focuses onto the resin target

**Model boundary:** slowed 2D geometric preview only; no scan linearization, voxel timing map, dose, threshold, curing, aberration correction, or PrintImage control software.
